name: zlib
description: Search and download Z-Library books, fix e-book metadata, and send books to Kindle or WeRead.
long_description: Runs the zlib CLI as a local MCP server. Search Z-Library, read book details, download books, browse saved books and download history, look up and fix the metadata of local e-books, and send files to a Kindle or a WeRead shelf. It uses the Z-Library session you create with `zlib login` in a terminal (install the zlib CLI to log in); the agent never sees your password.

tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search Z-Library books with format, language, year and sort filters.

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Fetch a book's details and description by id:hash.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Show the account profile and daily quota.

tools.name: check_domains
tools.description: Probe Z-Library mirrors for reachable domains.

tools.name: download_book
tools.description: Download a book, optionally sending it to Kindle or WeRead.

tools.name: delete_download_history
tools.description: Remove an entry from remote download history.

tools.name: send_to_kindle
tools.description: Email a local e-book to the configured Kindle address.

tools.name: import_to_weread
tools.description: Import a local e-book into the WeRead shelf.

tools.name: lookup_metadata
tools.description: Look a book up in online catalogues and compare matches with a file.

tools.name: edit_metadata
tools.description: Write metadata into a local e-book and optionally rename it.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Expose only read tools: no downloads, history deletion, Kindle or WeRead delivery, or metadata editing.

allowed_directory.title: Allowed folder
allowed_directory.description: Keep downloads, Kindle attachments, WeRead imports and the metadata tools inside this folder. Leave empty for no limit.
